create_cohere2_config: create a Cohere2Config instance with default model settings for the Cohere2 transformer architecture
init_cohere2_model_from_config: initialize a Cohere2Model using a Cohere2Config configuration object
configure_cohere2_attention_heads: configure Cohere2Config with custom num_attention_heads and num_key_value_heads values
set_cohere2_layer_types: set Cohere2Config layer_types to alternate between sliding_attention and full_attention layers
load_cohere2_config_from_checkpoint: load a Cohere2Config from the CohereForAI/c4ai-command-r-v01 checkpoint
